notes:
Account snapshot: Polaris Pair builds a VS Code-focused pair-programming copilot plugin used by developer teams to get streaming inline completions and multi-cursor suggestions. Primary ask: low-latency streaming completions (p50 < 30ms, p99 < 120ms) for 512-token flows when using model pinning to vendor-provided LLMs.

Recent call highlights:
- Customer runs extension that opens a WS stream per editor session; concerned about rate limits causing dropped streams. Wants graceful backpressure and reconnect semantics.
- 'We need model/version pinning so enterprise customers get deterministic suggestions — can't have random model swaps.' — Head of Product.
- Security team requires SSO (SAML), audit logs, per-customer KMS option and retention rules; default hosted API ok for smaller customers but enterprise customers require VPC/dedicated.
- Cost sensitivity: tight on per-seat cost; exploring Redwood Optimize to tune batching and caching for suggestion endpoints.
- SE asked for sample payload sizes and typical idle times; extension sends frequent small prefix calls (avg 80 chars) plus occasional longer code-gen requests.

Current status: POC running against hosted API with transient Dedicated fallback test. Engineering concerned about token accounting for streaming partial tokens (billing clarity). Will run 2 more perf scenarios (cold start, context window 8k) week of 3/18.

Docs / links: security FAQ in drive; pricing deck has ded cap scenarios. Jira RDW-1298 opened for streaming QoS feature request.
